_about: TAP cryptographic suite registry. Machine-readable form of TAP-spec-v0.1.md §3.6 [TAP-SUITE-DISPATCH]. A Verifier MUST dispatch off the key's declared suite and MUST reject any suite absent from its own registry rather than falling back to a default.

suites.notes: The only suite implemented in v0.1.
Post-quantum, lattice. Reserved: no implementation exists. Signatures are ~50x Ed25519's, so they MUST ride in the body or _meta, never an HTTP header.
Post-quantum, hash-based; conservative archival choice. Reserved: no implementation exists.
